case_assignment_source: Each workflow row assigns Foundation, Microcopy IAR and integrated case IDs; validation requires exact-once inherited/new case assignment and complete message-state/action/projection/role/context/channel coverage.
assertions: Every one of the eighteen Foundation semantic message states and eighteen stable message objects is exercised by a nominal integrated workflow.
All nine roles, twenty contexts, seven delivery channels, twelve Inspector projection groups, twenty action presentations and eleven authority handoffs appear in at least one integrated workflow.
All thirty-two Foundation cases, forty Microcopy IAR cases and thirty-six integrated workflow cases are assigned exactly once.

Permission and entitlement filtering plus minimum-field reduction occur before message discovery, interpolation, actions, counts, timing, diagnostics, support, exports, notifications and optional AI context.
Hidden and missing remain externally equivalent whenever existence is protected, including shape, actions, timing and visual/nonvisual behavior.
Status unknown is not failure; ambiguous mutations use operation-status lookup before retry, and idempotent mutation retry is only a presentation of upstream safe-retry authority.
Offline/local state never implies authoritative mutation; reconnect never implies success; accepted durable Event and displayed projection remain distinct.
Stale/conflict copy cannot overwrite or resolve; approval copy cannot decide; entitlement copy cannot reveal a protected catalog item.
F025 governs Help, support, diagnostics and issue reporting; secrets, raw logs, hidden payloads, unauthorized reasons and policy internals remain excluded.
PPIA-13 retains concept teaching; PPIA-14 owns final state wording and safe next-action presentation only.
P14-GAP-001 / F024 remains open; source-gap wording cannot invent Pack lifecycle behavior and collapses to safe-unavailable when the gap fact is protected.
Application runtime, STAGE-A-A2, release, deployment, tester access, paid services and production credentials remain inactive.
